st.t: Kids Creations - 197 - Remembering Pramukh Swami Maharaj
w: This year, Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Birthday is on 22 December. Write a short prasang of Pramukh Swami Maharaj which inspires you or share a memory (smruti) of him which you really like.

Jai Swaminarayan One of the prasang of Pramukh Swami Mahraj that is inspiring me is 7/7/1998 Bap's bypass surgery On that day the operation time was 12:00 but swami said we do it at 3:00. So bapa did jot even care about his life. When he was going to the operation theatre dr. Trivedi asked that what did you say we do operation at 3:00. At that time bapa said" thakorji no aram bagde etle apre operation 3:00vage rakhyu". So after the operation on next day Dr. Nilesh came for artierial puncture and bapa was taking with yogicharan swami but bapa's face rekha did not change so it did not pain for bapa. So that is inspiring me that never feel pain. Jayesh Bhadresa (11) Dar es salaam, TANZANIA

One prasang that inspires me to do the best bhakti I can is one that took place in London. Once, it was Pramukh Swami Maharaj's birthday. All of the Haribhakto's have made a birthday cake for swami Bapa. Swamishree was pleased but told the haribhakto's to offer the cake to Maharaj first. One Hari bhakta had said: "Swami Bapa we have already offered the cake to Harikrishna Maharaj. Now please eat some ". Bapa realized that the cake was not cut. He asked the Hari bhakta again: " How did you possibly offer the cake when it is not even cut? How will god eat it whole? Please offer it again ". On listening to Bapa's response everyone was delighted to see how much bhakti Bapa was willing to offer. In the same way, we should always think one step ahead and think about how we can do more bhakti then what we are doing right now. Sachi (11) Toronto , CANADA

Jai swaminarayan, A prasang of Pramukh Swami Maharaj that inspires me the most is about his firmness in Niyamdharma. When Pramukh swami Maharaj was young his name was Shantilal and he used to live in Chansad with his parents. There was a man named Chhotabhai, who was fond of children and used to give them toys and food etc. Once he arranged big feast for all children. Shantilal went there with his friends. All children were so excited to eat all delicious food. However Shantilal refused to eat as there was a day of ekadashi and non of the food were suitable to eat in ekadashi. All the people who gathered there tried to force him to eat. Shantilal started crying, so Chhotabhai has arranged special penda for Shantilal to eat. Maharshi (8) Coventry, UNITED KINGDOM

There is a small village called Odarka in the Saurashtra region. Odarka was known as the home of the infamous Ramsang Bapu (Ramsinhji Takhatsinhji Gohil). He was a skilled fighter and thief. He didn’t bother stealing from people or businesses, Ramsang Bapu terrorized villages! He was so good at what he did that Bhupat, a nationally feared gangster, offered a partnership. Bhupat had told Ramsang Bapu that with you on my side, I can rattle the national government. He offered half his profits to Ramsang Bapu, but Ramsingh Bapu was not interested in such high profile action. Describing his original nature, he would say, “If you had seen me before, you would have thought I was Ravan and Kansa’s brother! I was destined to die a very painful and humiliating death, but Pramukh Swami Maharaj changed my life.” Swamishri visited his house in Odarka and talked to him about the repercussions of violence, theft and hurting others. Ramsang Bapu followed Swamishri’s wish and started to live a morally pure life, giving up his vices and violent ways. Ramsang Bapu was no longer a thug or gangster. Pramukh Swami Maharaj had made him a devotee. His transformation helped the entire region sleep better at night. For the rest of his days, Ramsang Bapu lived a pious life based on the codes of satsang. On 13 October 1997, Swamishri promised Ramsang Bapu that Bhagwan Swaminarayan would take him to Akshardham very soon. In just 13 days, Ramsang Bapu breathed his last while telling his son Janaksinh, “Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Pramukh Swami Maharaj have come to take me. I am going...” Changing obvious misfits in society is common, but there is a type of transformation Swamishri brings about that is not as obvious. Swamishri’s divine aishvaraya has helped people rid themselves of anger, lust, greed and arrogance... Krishna Mandaliya (9) Melbourne , AUSTRALIA

I remember A prasang of Prumukh Swami Mahraj of when he was giving kanthies to children he did not know that one of them was a girl. The very next day when Prumukh Swami Maharaj found out that it was a girl he fasted just to stay firm in his Niyams. Moral: We should be firm in our niyams just like Pramukh Swami Mahraj. Dev Patel (9) Brisbane, AUSTRALIA

Jay Swaminarayan, There is my really Heart-touched smruti with pramukh swami once when I was 8 years old I was cycling with my friend and suddenly a huge truck came to our side I was going to trapped in it but suddenly I thought of something and I felt like pramukh swami is helping me and there was a pit and I sat down to that pit and I was saved!! I felt like pramukh swami has saved me this is one of the memorable moment of me with pramukh swami maharaj. Riya Upadhyay (13) Ahmedabad, INDIA

I remember when pramukh swami use to help the poor people when he saw them and also I heard a story that a boy was really sick and Pramukh swami went walking because the car broke down to the half way to the hospital and they were also digging up the ground but swamiji did not mind it he still went to see the boy by walking half way. krisha (11) toronto, CANADA

An incident took in the late 1971 in dharmaj, a village in Gujrat. This marked the 51st birthday of pramukh swami maharaj. In fact it was the first birthday celebration after he became the guru. It lasted for a period of 11 days. The last and the main day arrived. It marked the 51st birthday of pramukh swami maharaj. That morning, swami bapa got up and started brushing his teeth. He noticed used datan's lying around before him. He got up and gathered the used datans and put them into the dustbin. Wow!! Little seva on a big day. How nice is our guru. He has all the characteristics of being a guru.lets all put our hands together and bow down to him on his birthday and get his rajipo. Jay swaminarayan. Het patel (13) Kakamega, KENYA

Jai Swaminarayan Today I will tell a prasang of Pramukh Swami. Once at mid night he wake up and start chanting Swaminarayan mantra for the end of drought in India. Upasana Bhadresa (10) Dar Es Salaam, TANZANIA

The smruti I really like about bapa and mahant swami maharaj is when they do puja they are so concentrated on their puja. They listen to the things that balaks are saying and other hari bhatos. Some balaks say full vachanamruts and some say some Swamini Vato which are quite hard and they have to memorise. When they feed the prasad to the maharaj he looks at them so concentrated that it acutely looks like they are eating with their heart. When their puja is finished they read the Vachanamrut and Swamini Vato and they read it so carefully that they don’t even think of looking up to the hari bhaktos. Which sometimes makes me feel that we should do puja so concentrated so that bhagwan actually comes in our puja and that they actually give ashirvad. Kshama Gohil (9) Adelaide , AUSTRALIA

One story that inspired me was when Pramukh Swami Maharaj gave up his own glasses and gave it to another person who needed glasses. Pramukh Swami Maharaj cares about us so much and so we should care about him the same way as well. Chirayu Gohil (12) Adelaide, AUSTRALIA
Swamishri left Nakuru at 10.00 am and reached Nairobi by noon. A kirtan-bhakti program was performed by sadhus in the evening assembly.

w: The Sharad Punam festival was celebrated at the Edison mandir in the evening. During the assembly the president of Queens International Club, Mr. John Hogan, said, "I am really happy to be here with you all this evening. I can see the wonderful work being done here... The thing that inspires me the most is that everything here is done so cooperatively. The people in the parking lot, the kitchen and everywhere are so nice. You don't see that kind of thing anywhere. I would like the people at large to see all this being done here." Mr. Hogan then honored Swamishri by presenting the 'Person of the Century' plaque.
Then a colorful, festive procession of the murti of Gunatitanand Swami was carried out in celebration of Sharad Punam festival.
During Swamishri's morning puja, the kishores sang a variety of bhajans on the Swaminarayan Mantra.

In the evening, Swamishri arrived for the special Kishore Day program. A fusion of bhajans and dialogues, traditionally called a 'dayro', on the theme of 'Atheists become Theists' was brilliantly performed by kishores. Amidst a village backdrop, when a group of rural people were regaling in a 'dayro' they were challenged by a group of academic students to prove the existence of God. Then how the students were convinced brilliantly unfolded through the 'dayro'. Swamishri finally blessed the assembly by elaborating upon the existence and glory of God.

At 9.25 a.m., Swamishri departed from Bhuj and traveled 60 km to Gunatitpur - reconstructed by BAPS after the earthquake. The BAPS has built 112 houses, a primary school, administrative office, community hall, dispensary water storage tank, roads, a pond, etc. ( For details ). Swamishri sanctified the newly built village and performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of the Swaminarayan Mandir. Swamishri then addressed the satsang assembly.

At 5.35 p.m., Swamishri arrived at Yoginagar built by BAPS after the earthquake. 87 houses, a mandir, primary school, play school, community hall, administrative office, gaushala, etc. Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals at the Swaminarayan Mandir and blessed the assembly. Thereafter, Swamishri returned to Bhuj and addressed the evening assembly.

In the evening satsang assembly, the kishores performed a drama entitled ‘Khoj’. Following this, in his blessings Swamishri said, “Bad worldly habits are present in all. So if bad things are seen outside, this stimulates bad thoughts within. One acts as one has seen. So, engage in satsang and read good scriptures. But nowadays people do not spare time for reading good scriptures. The Bhagvat, Gita, Ramayan, Mahabharat, Bhagwan Swaminarayan’s Vachanamrut are all excellent. They contain the answers to all our questions.”

From today the 25-day long Akshardham Festival commenced with Swamishri’s puja in the giant marquee in Pramukh Swami Nagar. Every evening a satsang assembly was held from 5.00 pm to 8.30 pm in which Sadhu Adarshjivandas elaborated upon Swaminarayancharit Manas – the life of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Thereafter, a cultural dance was performed by BAPS children, a guest speaker addressed the assembly and Swamishri finally blessed the congregation. Guest Speaker – Pujya Satyamitranandgiriji spoke brilliantly on “Tena Tyaktena Bhujithaha.” Pujya Satyamitranandgiriji said, “Pramukh Swami Maharaj has created Akshardham, a new ‘world’. Here, people will derive inspiration and get the opportunity of having darshan and contemplation of our culture. After pilgrimaging the four Himalaya pilgrim places this has become the fifth. If anyone does not come here then his pilgrimage will be unfinished. What Swamiji has created cannot be conceived in our dreams.”

Over 700 balaks and balikas attended the National Bal-Balika Shibir in the presence of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. The theme of the shibir was upasana. A short video clip was presented to Swamishri after he completed his morning puja. It was based on the four concepts of ‘Sarvopari’, ‘Sakar’, ‘Karta’ and ‘Pragat’ in the form of a police investigation determining the factors behind Shastriji Maharaj’s establishment of the BAPS in 1907, and how he achieved success with such meagre resources. The core of the morning and afternoon programme was in the format of classroom sessions where participants were divided into four groups according to age, wherein they got knowledge and understanding of the key principles of upasana in an interactive environment. The evening programme was presented in the assembly hall before Swamishri and thousands of devotees. A debate-style drama by balaks discussed the existence of God through logical arguments. This was followed by a series of excellent mono-acts from balaks representing famous devotees from the past. Thereafter, the balaks performed a dance extolling the Satpurush as the inspirer and nourisher of values, and the destroyer of bad habits. Finally, in his blessings, Swamishri praised the efforts of the balaks and balikas and explained the four elements of upasana with practical examples.

st.t: BAPS News – National Bal-Balika Shibir 2007 – Saturday 13 October 2007
w: Over 700 balaks and balikas gathered at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London on Saturday 13 October 2007 for the National Bal-Balika Shibir in the presence of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. The theme of the Shibir revolved around upasana, in the form of a police investigation determining the factors behind Shastriji Maharaj’s establishment of BAPS in 1907, and how he achieved greatness with such meagre resources.

The findings of the investigation which unfolded throughout the course of the day revealed that it was because of the main aspects of upasana – ‘Sarvopari’, ‘Sakar’, ‘Karta’, and ‘Pragat’ – that Shastriji Maharaj established BAPS.
The investigation was launched with a news report-style video which was presented to Swamishri. Following breakfast, the children gathered inside the Haveli for an entertaining magic show.

The core of the morning and afternoon programme was in the format of classroom sessions where participants were divided into four groups according to age, wherein they developed their knowledge and understanding of the key principles of upasana in an interactive environment.

The evening programme provided great entertainment as balaks performed a variety of activities on the theme of upasana. A debate-style drama by balaks on the subject of Swaminarayan and Hinduism, with enactments of professionals such as doctors, executives and lawyers posing questions to a panel of balaks on the existence of God through their logical arguments was followed by a series of excellent mono-acts from balaks representing famous devotees from the past. The performances recreated incidents from their lives that supported the four pillars of the Akshar-Purushottam Upasana. Thereafter, the balaks performed a dance extolling the Satpurush as the inspirer and nourisher of values, and the destroyer of bad habits.

In his blessings, Swamishri praised the efforts of the balaks and balikas, mentioning that although they appear small in age, their theme was great and that we must understand and imbibe this in our lives. Swamishri systematically explained the four elements of upasana with practical examples, and emphasised that despite our endeavours to attain worldly objects, there is nothing greater than the attainment of God.

The grand finale to the memorable day was provided by Swamishri, as he lofted a paper plane into the air to depict the two wings of Akshardham – ‘agna’ and ‘upasana’ – and propel us on the path of salvation.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of the murtis for new BAPS hari mandirs in Meta Khambhaliya, Malod and Bavavala suburb (Jetpur).
Diligence in work

3 October 2009, Gondal Swamishri read the letters of three devotees of Jamnagar, each asking him to put a mark on their site plans for drilling bore wells. Swamishri said that the annual rainfall in Jamnagar was quite good, so why do the devoees wish to have bore wells. To satisty his enquiry Swamishri telephoned Dharmanidhi Swami, who is in charge of Satsang activities in Jamnagar. Only then did Swamishri make a mark on their site plans. Swamishri is meticulous in all his works and spends time to fully understand the problems and wishes of devotees.
Swamishri’s compassion

10 October 2009, Gondal Yogiswarup Swami, the Kothari of Rajkot mandir, informed Swamishri of a devotee’s terminal illness, “In Yogiji Maharaj’s time, Mathurbhai had done a lot of seva in Gondal mandir. At present he is in a hospital in Rajkot suffering from cancer. His relatives are not able to take care of him. So, we send food daily for him from the mandir and take care of him.” Swamishri acknowledged Mathurbhai’s seva , “We must take care of him. He has done a lot of seva .” “But Swami, he does not follow the doctor’s prescribed diet,” Yogiswarup Swami added. “Send food only in accordance to the doctor’s advice. And, serve Mathurbhai regardless of his nature and inclinations.”Swamishri never forgets a devotee’s service for Satsang. In times of need he helps and showers his compassion upon all.
Mahant Swami Maharaj arrived at the assembly. A programme titled "Iti Vachanamrutam!" had been arranged here. The reader began to read.

There was some discussion about how the Satpurush (the true, God-realised Sadhu) should be understood. Different opinions came up, such as a towering peak of saintliness, management... Then Swamishri himself was requested, "Only you can describe the true glory of the Satpurush, so please kindly tell us the glory of the Satpurush."
Swamishri said, "He constantly holds God within. That is the greatest power of all. Everything else can be done, but holding God within cannot be done."
After that a session of questions and answers began.
Question: At the start of the assembly, the kirtan "Divya Sabhapatiray..." was being sung. At that time you sat in meditation. So on which murti (sacred image) were you meditating?
Swamishri said, "It is a very straightforward matter. I met Yogibapa, so I meditated on him."
